findings.one_line: The proposal's all-strata measurable attainment claim remains an explicit open question: the delivered pilot-split result attains the conditional cutoff only on bounded-or-pilot-resolvable strata, a strict weakening that must be surfaced as the paper's scope or closed by a raw-sample construction.

State theorem-level novelty against Gunsilius's discrete DSC limit and Zhang--Zhang--Zhang's DSC asymptotics: specify which assumptions, loss object, simultaneous two-sample phases, and face/collision regimes are absent there, rather than relying on the general related-work paragraph.

The claimed novelty of the feasible certified radius needs a precise closest-result comparison (especially discrete-quantile inference, DSC inference, and conditional/active-set calibration): identify the exact result and say why its guarantee does not supply this restricted pilot-resolvable theorem.

Position the honest-ball and diameter claim at theorem level against discrete quantile-band inference and existing DSC inference, including whether the two lower-bound subexperiments and the m^(-1/4) diameter conclusion are new in this exact stable-span DSC class.
